exercises.title: Technology & Social Media — Reading
exercises.passage: For one week, Nora stopped checking social media before breakfast. She has noticed that she feels calmer in the morning. Last Monday, she switched off notifications and left her phone in another room. She still uses the internet for schoolwork, but she now checks whether websites are reliable.

questions.question: What did she do last Monday?

exercises.title: Technology & Social Media — Listening
exercises.script: Presenter: Have you ever deleted a social media app? Alex: Yes, I deleted one last year. Presenter: Have you downloaded it again? Alex: No, I have not. I spend more time reading now.
exercises.audio_source: TTS script. Needs audio recording or speech synthesis integration.
